elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence".

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000".

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "where HDI processes the Company's customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000" — conditional trigger mirrors the element.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "workers' compensation insurance as required by law".

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "HDI shall provide certificates of insurance upon the Company's request."

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: E&O set at USD 2,000,000, which satisfies the at-least USD 1,000,000 floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Cyber and privacy liability set at USD 5,000,000 where HDI processes Company customer data, exceeding the USD 2,000,000 floor.

reasons: The document contains no insurance covenant (General Provisions 10.1–10.8 run from notices to headings), so the rule is properly scored as missing and a concise insertion is the right instrument.

Inserted Section 10.9 states every preferred element in operative language: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, conditional cyber USD 5M where HDI processes Company customer data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request.

Minimality holds: the drafter dropped the model-language extras ("at its own expense" and the one-year survival tail) and added nothing beyond the checklist; no existing favourable language was deleted and no operative term is duplicated.

Intent is preserved: 10.8 is retained verbatim, the new paragraph is numbered sequentially within Section 10, uses the parties' existing names (HDI, the Company), and introduces no undefined term or dangling cross-reference.
Both levels are complete, so the redline sits at the preferred position with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) correctly held in reserve in the comment rather than in the operative text.
